description: This file contains PHP unit tests for the ProjectActivityDetailedReportDataAPI class within the OrangeHRM Time Plugin. It sets up test data, mocks API calls, and verifies the behavior of the API method 'getAll' using a data provider. The class extends the EndpointIntegrationTestCase to perform integration testing of the API endpoint for project activity detailed reports.

classes.name: ProjectActivityDetailedReportDataAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the ProjectActivityDetailedReportDataAPI's 'getAll' method via API endpoint integration.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Static setup method that populates test data fixtures from YAML files before any tests are run.

methods.description: Test method for the 'getAll' API endpoint, using a data provider to run multiple test cases.
